name: After recital U
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: Ua. whereas the Global Gateway is a costly attempt to emulate China’s Belt and Road Initiative, which has served as a major instrument for advancing China’s economic and strategic interests, while the Global Gateway has so far failed to demonstrate comparable results or clear and measurable benefits for EU citizens despite the unprecedented amounts of taxpayer money committed to it;
